best_bets.rule: Per game, the single selection with the highest EV among those with model P > 50% and EV > 0 when buying at the Jupiter ask (YES or NO) including trading fees; otherwise NO BET.
best_bets.ev_formula: EV per $1 = p_model / (ask + fee per contract) - 1
best_bets.markets: full-time goals markets priced from the frozen score grid: 1X2 (YES/NO), BTTS, totals, team totals, spreads, exact score. Half-time, corners and first-to-score are not modelled.
